My principles

I start with the people who will use it, test early, and keep every screen as clear as it can be. Good design should feel obvious.

Getting to know me

Building games taught me how things work. Watching people play them made me curious about how things feel. That curiosity led me to UI/UX.

Now I design apps and websites the same way I used to test levels: watch real people use them, notice where they get stuck, and fix it until it feels effortless.
